relations.name: invoice_record
relations.meaning: A billed revenue row as represented in billing sources with native invoice identifier and attributes.
relations.grounding_contract: One tuple per invoice in sources/billing/invoices.json; each field copied verbatim from the source row.
relations.construction_rule: C1 parse invoices.json; mint thin referent per invoice_id; assert one tuple per array element with SOURCE grounding on the row.

relations.name: crm_account_record
relations.meaning: A CRM account row with native account identifier and displayed account name.
relations.grounding_contract: One tuple per data row in sources/crm.csv; account_name copied verbatim.
relations.construction_rule: C1 parse crm.csv; mint thin referent per crm_account_id; assert account_name from the row with SOURCE grounding.

relations.name: registry_record
relations.meaning: A company registry row with registry number and legal name as represented.
relations.grounding_contract: One tuple per data row in sources/company_registry.csv; fields copied verbatim.
relations.construction_rule: C1 parse company_registry.csv; mint thin referent per company_number; assert legal_name with SOURCE grounding on the row.

relations.name: contract_record
relations.meaning: A contract document identified by source filename stem with counterparty text as stated in the document header.
relations.grounding_contract: One tuple per markdown file in sources/contracts/; contract_id is filename without .md; counterparty from the Counterparty line.
relations.construction_rule: C1 enumerate sources/contracts/*.md; mint thin referent per file; parse header Counterparty field; assert contract_id and counterparty_text with SOURCE grounding on the file span.

relations.name: contract_lifecycle
relations.meaning: Whether a contract is in force or expired as a source-grounded lifecycle fact independent of purpose inclusion policy.
relations.grounding_contract: active reflects explicit Effective/Expiry/Term statements and document-type cues in contract sources (e.g., expired SOW with stated expiry date).
relations.construction_rule: C1 parse contract headers and stated expiry or non-renewal language; set active=false when source explicitly marks expired or past expiry; set active=true when no explicit expiry or when term continues without stated termination; ground each boolean on the supporting source span.

relations.name: clause_kind_present
relations.meaning: A contract contains, lacks, or unclearly states a normalized clause kind extracted from contract text.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded evidence packet citing contract section text or explicit silence; ACCEPT and REJECT require establishing textual evidence, not inference from deal type alone.
relations.construction_rule: C2 read each contract body; for each candidate clause_kind in the union of purpose A acquisition kinds and purpose C obligation kinds, judge presence from section text; persist ACCEPT/REJECT/UNRESOLVED with grounding spans.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit one candidate per (contract, clause_kind) pair where clause_kind is drawn from contracts/purpose_a.json allowed_kinds union contracts/purpose_c.json allowed_kinds.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Contract language is ambiguous, cross-references an unseen document, or section boundaries do not support a confident ACCEPT or REJECT.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two referents denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility or string similarity alone.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3 for each generated candidate pair, resolve to SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED with evidence; mechanical legal-form variants may be resolved in C1 via mechanical_identity_allowance before semantic review.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate directed pairs required to wire each commercial relationship: crm account, its billed name, governing contract identifier, and registry candidates suggested by name overlap or commercial_notes.md; include billing-to-contract counterparty pairs needed for invoice association; exclude exhaustive all-pairs Cartesian product.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Insufficient evidence to assert SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT; preferred over speculative merge on similar trade names.

relations.name: governing_contract_link
relations.meaning: An invoice is governed by a specific contract, or that governance linkage remains unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: ASSERTED requires confident evidence tying the invoice billed relationship to the contract (explicit source statement, filename stem correspondence, or established identity chain); UNRESOLVED when linkage cannot be confidently established.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3 for each invoice, judge which contract governs the billed revenue; persist ASSERTED or UNRESOLVED per candidate (invoice, contract) pair; do not treat missing linkage as negative non-governance.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per invoice crossed with contracts plausibly governing that commercial relationship (filename stem hints, commercial_notes.md assertions, CRM-to-contract wiring).
relations.unresolved_judgment: No authoritative source ties the invoice to a single governing contract with confidence.

relations.name: canonical_identifier
relations.meaning: Purpose-prescribed string identifier form for a thin referent (crm:, billing:, registry:, contract:).
relations.grounding_contract: Deterministic formatting from compiled mechanical records; no semantic judgment.
relations.construction_rule: C4 derive identifier strings: crm:<crm_account_id>, billing:<billed_name>, registry:<company_number>, contract:<contract_id> from invoice_record, crm_account_record, registry_record, and contract_record inputs.

relations.name: mechanical_identity_allowance
relations.meaning: Exact legal-form variants of the same registered name collapse to SAME_ENTITY without semantic review.
relations.grounding_contract: Deterministic normalization (case, punctuation, Ltd/Limited, Inc.) applied to registry legal_name pairs and billing names explicitly equated in commercial_notes.md.
relations.construction_rule: C4 emit SAME_ENTITY pairs where normalized legal names match exactly or commercial_notes.md explicitly states equivalence (e.g., Helion Robotics Ltd vs Helion Robotics Limited); feed identity_judgment construction as pre-accepted tuples with DERIVATION grounding.

relations.name: open_invoice
relations.meaning: Invoices whose billing status is open as represented in source.
relations.grounding_contract: Filter invoice_record where status equals open; deterministic.
relations.construction_rule: C4 SELECT from invoice_record WHERE status = 'open'.

relations.name: acquisition_relevant_clause
relations.meaning: A clause kind on a contract that satisfies purpose A acquisition-relevance policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Project clause_kind_present tuples with disposition ACCEPT and clause_kind in purpose A allowed_kinds; analytical filter only.
relations.construction_rule: C4 join clause_kind_present to purpose A allowed_kinds where disposition = ACCEPT; does not persist as world truth.

relations.name: purpose_a_qualifying_invoice
relations.meaning: An invoice included under purpose A row-inclusion policy with association asserted or unresolved per identity confidence on billed counterparty linkage.
relations.grounding_contract: Row present when governing_contract_link is ASSERTED, contract_lifecycle.active is true, and at least one acquisition_relevant_clause exists; association maps identity_judgment SAME_ENTITY on billing-to-contract counterparty pair to asserted, else unresolved.
relations.construction_rule: C4 select invoices meeting active-contract and acquisition-clause conjunction; compute association from identity_judgment between billing:<billed_name> and contract:<contract_id> via disposition_mapping in contracts/purpose_a.json; never omit qualifying rows solely for unresolved association.

relations.name: purpose_b_required_link
relations.meaning: Directed identity link required to connect CRM, billing, contract, and registry candidates for each commercial relationship under purpose B coverage policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Project identity_judgment (and mechanical_identity_allowance) for the required link set; orient pairs by class_rank per contracts/purpose_b.json; map REJECT to DISTINCT in output.
relations.construction_rule: C4 emit identity_judgment tuples for required wiring pairs sorted by left then right; completeness targets relationship connectivity, not global entity closure.

relations.name: commercial_dependency_row
relations.meaning: A counterparty-contract dependency candidate under purpose C two-part test with status dependent or unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: dependent when current commercial relationship (open invoice or active auto-renew/rolling contract) AND obligation kind present, and required identity joins are confident; unresolved when identity needed for the join is UNRESOLVED; excludes expired-only and historical one-off patterns per purpose policy.
relations.construction_rule: C4 for each active contract with ACCEPT obligation kinds from {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term}, test current relationship via open_invoice or contract term facts; set status dependent only when identity_judgment chain from counterparty identifier to invoice and contract is SAME_ENTITY; otherwise status unresolved.

relations.name: commercial_dependency_obligations
relations.meaning: Sorted obligation kinds present on an active contract for a purpose C dependency row.
relations.grounding_contract: Project clause_kind_present with disposition ACCEPT and clause_kind in purpose C allowed_kinds for contracts appearing in commercial_dependency_row.
relations.construction_rule: C4 join clause_kind_present to purpose C obligation vocabulary where disposition = ACCEPT; sort clause_kind ascending within each contract.

relations.name: commercial_dependency_open_invoices
relations.meaning: Open invoices linked to a counterparty-contract dependency row through confident identity and governance joins.
relations.grounding_contract: Open invoices joined via governing_contract_link ASSERTED and identity_judgment SAME_ENTITY on billing identifier to row counterparty; may be empty when relationship is contract-only.
relations.construction_rule: C4 join open_invoice to governing_contract_link and identity_judgment for each commercial_dependency_row; emit invoice_id list sorted ascending.
